# Fallout 76: Letter from the Directors - 2025

![Fallout 76: Letter from the Directors - 2025](/uploads/605_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The year is coming to an end and a lot has happened in Fallout 76. There were a lot of perk changes and balancing, the ability to play as a ghoul, master new fishing challenges, the CAMP construction menu was completely revised and there was another map expansion in December, this time west into the Ohio desert to Burning Springs. At the end of the year, Creative Director Jon Rush and Production Director Bill LaCoste have another letter to the community.

### Adventurers from Appalachia,

Fallout 76 celebrated its seven-year anniversary on November 14th this year. Seven years have passed since its release in 2018, during which more than 23 million Vault dwellers have overslept and hastily left the Vault. 23 million players! Vault 76 must be gigantic! And what a MONSTERFUL Reconquest Day party that must have been! The Vault Dwellers have left their cozy, Vault-Tec-assigned homes and entered a breathtaking, previously unknown wasteland in the FABULOUS Fallout universe. With their first steps into the freedom of our Appalachia, the players made history. Since then, we have experienced new stories together and created our own stories on adventures with our friends. And with every minute we spent on the back roads of Appalachia, we made an impact on Fallout's story. On top of that, November 14th marks the tenth anniversary since full development work on Fallout 76 began. What an incredible journey we've experienced together so far! Let's take a look at what happened this year...The year 2025 began with “The Inner Ghoul”. After years of intense radiation exposure, our players were finally able to transform their characters into a ghoul! This gave you players an exciting end-game experience that allowed you to customize your character in dozens of different ways. Ghoulification brought with it unique ghoul properties such as high radiation resistance, a "feral gauge" to help you stay sane - just no holding back on chems - and a powerful radiation collection mechanic called "Glow". And of course we don't want to forget the thirty new ghoul skill cards that have been added to the existing variants for humans.
**“Smooth skin is completely overrated anyway, don’t you agree?” – Bill LaCoste***

The atomic anglers among you had a reason to celebrate when you finally got to cast your rod on the waters of Appalachia. It's been a really HOT summer in Appalachia, and there's no better way to cool off than to go fishing in the cool water.
**“Where you can swim, you can fish.” – Captain Nuke McCloud***

The sentence immediately makes you want to explore Appalachia again and discover what lurks in the waters of the entire region. Fifty species of fish have found their way into the waters of our mountainous region, with Burning Springs adding a few more and the biodiversity will continue to be expanded with seasonal content in the future.
**"The fish may look a little weird, but they don't taste that bad. And in the Wasteland, 'not so bad' means 'pretty good'!" – Jon Rush***

The “C.A.M.P. Renovation Update” was released in the fall, and its size is reminiscent of a really swanky villa! We have revised the C.A.M.P. workshop menus to make it easier to search through thousands of C.A.M.P. items... ... and we ha
